items.name: Warm Apple Oat Crumble
steps: Prepare the sliced apples and spread them in a shallow baking dish.
Dot with half the ghee and sprinkle over the cinnamon and sweetener.
Combine the rolled oats and chopped almonds with the remaining ghee and scatter them evenly.
Bake until the fruit is soft and bubbling and the topping is gently browned.
Rest for ten minutes and serve warm in small portions.
items.guidance: Warm Apple Oat Crumble is a warm fruit dessert with restrained sweetener. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.

items.name: Amaranth Jaggery Dessert Squares
steps: Toast the popped amaranth and sesame seeds gently, then cool.
Grind the toasted ingredients to a coarse meal.
Work in the jaggery, ghee, and cardamom until the mixture holds when pressed.
Shape into 12 small pieces with clean hands.
Rest until set and serve one piece per portion.
